observations.detail: repository.py declares keyword-only acquire/heartbeat/CAS inputs; retry_job is concrete SQLite API, absent from SimulationJobRepository Protocol. Exact signatures in files.

publication_guard is per resolved DB/PID RLock + flock with same-thread reentry, yields None; it is not a transaction receipt. acquire is wrapped, heartbeat/release are not. acquire calculates now/deadline before BEGIN IMMEDIATE; heartbeat samples now after BEGIN IMMEDIATE and rowcount1 rejects dead/cancelled/mismatched lease.

InMemorySimulationJobRepository subclasses SQLiteSimulationJobRepository and owns TemporaryDirectory/runtime.db; close cleans its temporary directory. SQLite _connect is isolation_level=None and finally explicitly closes per-call connection.

Memory uses nonreentrant threading.Lock; SQLite uses nonreentrant _write_lock and persistent _conn. Bootstrap/supervision/publication/routing writes derive/check under event repository lock; SQLite writes BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Typed transition request normalization precedes lock. There is currently no shared job/event transaction authority parameter.

poll_once acquire -> heartbeat thread -> _execute -> finally heartbeat.join(timeout=1), release and revoke. _execute takes publication_guard and real start_attempt; after RUNNING it calls _prepare_startup/from_worker/_begin_origin then records original monotonic/UTC tuple and seals it before _run/RESET/settle. Late _new_handoff binds source+limits; runtime consumes via exact binding and actual backend episode _consume_handoff, token popped once. Public WorkerRuntimeSource alone does not authorize new owner.

ArtifactRecoveryService.recover_interrupted_jobs expires leases first, under publication_guard verifies current snapshot identity, finishes open attempts and CASes INTERRUPTED to RECOVERY_PENDING; requeue only explicit flag. service.start recovers before dispatcher.start. SQLite retry retains job identity/manifest/repro hash but clears lease/worker/cancel; new attempt authority cannot reuse ended owner.

vision/execution.py dispatches to raw_recorder.execute_attempt or edge.runtime.skill_executor.SkillExecutor.execute_attempt. Runtime definition.handler(robot, validated_parameters, step.timeout_ms) is the actual submission boundary after preconditions. edge/skill_executor.py is legacy execute_step; covering only it misses normal runtime.

MuJoCoPhysicsBackend.step: operation observer branch -> control/actuator/_advance_observed_physics_step; no physics observer branch -> control/actuator/mj_step; physics observer branch -> control/actuator/mj_step/callback. _apply_control dequeues due pending targets and writes arm ctrl; apply_joint_targets mutates queue or targets; apply_gripper_command writes gripper ctrl. Guards needed at actual consumption must cover all branches, queue consumption and gripper.

All observer contexts unregister in finally; physics/actuator allow one current observer and prohibit backend mutation/reentrant stepping in callbacks. Operation hook is independent read-only recording with retained failure/allocation ledger, not dispatch permission. Recorder enters operation context and flushes/finally exits; purpose and execute_attempt retain interval/error disposition.

ExperimentClock measures monotonic elapsed and maps request waits to physics advance. RawRecorderV3 _clock_pair samples monotonic_ns before/after independent UTC reading; purpose interval allocates before side-effect work and closes in finally. Existing interval evidence does not itself confer mutation authority.

runtime_source params memory/sqlite, real SQLite job/lease/attempt plus public WorkerRuntimeSource and copied role/runtime sources. SQLite events.close after yield only; Memory events not explicitly closed in this old fixture. configured transitively reuses it, SQL updates original job policy. This legacy public fixture is unsuitable for granting P6 live authority. Two files have source-derived 46+29=75 nodes, not collected or run.

software_factory(monkeypatch,tmp_path,*,during_initialize=None,during_settle=None,during_episode=None) uses _cpu_visual_worker, SQLite jobs/events and real SimulationWorker.poll_once lifecycle while replacing physical APIs and episode. It returns repos/worker/backend/events without automatic teardown. Existing P5 exercise calls it, poll_once and finally events.close; CPU close_call_count confirms owner revocation. Case root must exist before source.mkdir, use fresh independent roots and explicit event cleanup.

remaining_plan_decisions: R113 must name actual runtime SkillExecutor scope, not legacy-only executor; bind interface/handler transaction guard explicitly.
R113 must bind lock order/job lease sample point and event write atomicity without treating publication_guard yield None as signed authority.
R113 must fix exact new broker/view signatures, lifetime, retry/recovery/heartbeat invalidation semantics using genuine private worker origin; do not reuse ended P4/P5 owners.
R113 must specify CPU fixtures for memory/sqlite event stores and all three physics branches without public-source self authorization, fresh roots, cleanup and exact node list/argv.
R113 must separately retain native future UNKNOWN/NOT_SUPPORTED and software-vs-actual acceptance boundaries; no model/render/actual in this preflight.
